content: 1. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of tasimelteon by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution or consider alternative drugs. Close monitoring is recommended. 2. Tazemetostat decreases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is serious, and alternative drugs should be used. Close monitoring is advised. 3. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of tazemetostat by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Close monitoring is necessary. 4. Tecovirimat increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 metabolism. Tecovirimat is a weak inhibitor of CYP2C8 and CYP2C19. Use caution and monitor closely. 5. Tecovirimat decreases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Tecovirimat is a weak CYP3A4 inducer. Monitor sensitive CYP3A4 substrates for effectiveness if coadministered. Close monitoring is required. 6. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of temsirolimus by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 7. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of teniposide by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. 8. Nelfinavir and tenofovir DF both increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Use caution and monitor closely. 9. Tepotinib increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid or use alternative drugs. If concomitant use is unavoidable, reduce the P-gp substrate dosage as recommended in its approved product labeling. Close monitoring is essential. 10. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of terbinafine by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 11. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of tezacaftor by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Adjust the tezacaftor dosage regimen if coadministered with a strong CYP3A inhibitor. Close monitoring is required. 12. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of theophylline by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 13. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of tiagabine by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Close monitoring is necessary. 14. Nelfinavir increases levels of ticagrelor by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Ticagrelor is metabolized by CYP3A4/5. Avoid use with strong CYP3A inhibitors. 15. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of tinidazole by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 16. Tipranavir increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Close monitoring is required. 17. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of tipranavir by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Both drugs increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Use caution and monitor closely. 18. Nelfinavir increases levels of tisotumab vedotin by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Its active metabolite (MMAE) is a CYP3A4 substrate. Coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase unconjugated MMAE systemic exposure and the risk of adverse effects. Use caution and monitor closely. 19. Nelfinavir increases levels of tofacitinib by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Reduce the tofacitinib dose to 5 mg once daily when coadministered with potent CYP3A4 inhibitors. Close monitoring is necessary. 20. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of tolterodine by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 21. Tolvaptan increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. This interaction is serious, and alternative drugs should be used. Close monitoring is advised. 22. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of tolvaptan by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Close monitoring is required. 23. Topiramate decreases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is serious, and alternative drugs should be used. Close monitoring is advised. 24. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of topotecan by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Product labeling for oral topotecan recommends avoiding concomitant use of P-gp inhibitors. The interaction with IV topotecan may be less severe but still clinically significant. Close monitoring is necessary. 25. Nelfinavir increases levels of toremifene by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Toremifene metabolism may be inhibited by drugs known to inhibit CYP3A4 hepatic enzymes. 26. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of trabectedin by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. If a strong CYP3A inhibitor must be used short-term (e.g., less than 14 days), administer the strong CYP3A inhibitor one week after trabectedin infusion and discontinue the day prior to the next trabectedin infusion. Close monitoring is required. 27. Nelfinavir increases levels of tramadol by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. There is potential for increased toxicity. 28. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of trazodone by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Trazodone decreases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. 29. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of triamcinolone acetonide injectable suspension by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 30. Nelfinavir increases levels of triazolam by decreasing its metabolism. This interaction is contraindicated. Close monitoring is essential. 31. Triclabendazole increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by affecting hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 32. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of trimipramine by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 33. Tucatinib increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. This interaction is serious, and alternative drugs should be used. Close monitoring is advised. 34. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of tucatinib by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Avoid concomitant use of tucatinib with CYP3A substrates where minimal concentration changes may lead to serious or life-threatening toxicities. If unavoidable, reduce the CYP3A substrate dose according to product labeling. Close monitoring is required. 35. Ublituximab decreases the effects of nelfinavir due to immunosuppressive effects, increasing the risk of infection. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 36. Nelfinavir increases levels of ubrogepant by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is contraindicated. Close monitoring is essential. 37. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of ulipristal by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 38. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of umeclidinium bromide/vilanterol inhaled by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Vilanterol is a CYP3A4 substrate; coadministration with potent CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase systemic exposure. 39. Nelfinavir increases levels of upadacitinib by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Exercise caution if upadacitinib is coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 40. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of valbenazine by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Reduce the valbenazine dose to 40 mg once daily when coadministered with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor. 41. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of valsartan by other mechanisms (e.g., hepatic uptake transporter OATP1B1). Use caution and monitor closely. Coadministration with OATP1B1 inhibitors may increase valsartan systemic exposure. 42. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of vamorolone by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Reduce the vamorolone starting dose to 4 mg/kg/day, not exceeding 200 mg/day if weight >50 kg. 43. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of vardenafil by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. The vardenafil dose may need to be reduced if coadministered with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. 44. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of velpatasvir by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 45. Nelfinavir increases levels of vemurafenib by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Vemurafenib increases levels of nelfinavir by the same mechanism. This interaction is serious, and alternative drugs should be used. Close monitoring is advised. 46. Nelfinavir increases levels of venetoclax by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is contraindicated. Use of strong CYP3A4 inhibitors is contraindicated with venetoclax during the initial ramp-up dosing phase. 47. Nelfinavir increases levels of venetoclax by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Avoid or use alternative drugs. If a P-gp inhibitor must be used, reduce the venetoclax dose by at least 50%. Monitor more closely for signs of venetoclax toxicities. 48. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of verapamil by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Verapamil increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by the same mechanism and by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. 49. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of vilanterol/fluticasone furoate inhaled by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Both fluticasone furoate and vilanterol are CYP3A4 substrates; coadministration with potent CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase systemic exposure. 50. Nelfinavir increases levels of vilazodone by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. If intolerable adverse effects occur when coadministered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors, reduce the daily dose to 20 mg. 51. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of vinblastine by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. 52. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of vincristine by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. 53. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of vincristine liposomal by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. 54. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of vinorelbine by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. 55. Nelfinavir increases levels of voclosporin by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. This interaction is contraindicated. 56. Vonoprazan decreases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This applies only to the oral form of both agents. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 57. Nelfinavir increases levels of vorapaxar by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. 58. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of voriconazole by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Voriconazole increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by the same mechanism. Avoid or use alternative drugs. Close monitoring is required. 59. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of voxilaprevir by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 60. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of warfarin by other mechanisms. Warfarin's less potent R-enantiomer is metabolized in part by CYP3A4 (and also CYP1A2 and CYP2C19). Monitor INR more frequently if coadministered with inhibitors of these isoenzymes and adjust the warfarin dose if needed. 61. Zafirlukast increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 62. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of zaleplon by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. 63. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of zanubrutinib by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Reduce zanubrutinib (a CYP3A4 substrate) to 80 mg once daily if coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Interrupt the dose as recommended for adverse reactions. After discontinuing the CYP3A4 inhibitor, resume the previous zanubrutinib dose. 64. Nelfinavir and zidovudine both increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Use caution and monitor closely. 65. Nelfinavir increases levels of zileuton by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. There is potential for increased toxicity. 66. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of ziprasidone by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. 67. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of zolpidem by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. 68. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of zonisamide by affecting hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. 69. Nelfinavir increases the levels or effects of zuranolone by influencing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely.
